feat(discount): add SPRING15 code and make code lookup case-insensitive

Add SPRING15 (15% off) to the CODES table in src/discount.js.

Normalize the incoming code with String(code).toUpperCase() before the
lookup, so "spring15" and "SPRING15" resolve to the same rate. Before
this change, lowercase input silently got no discount. This applies to
all existing codes too (WELCOME10, VIP20). Non-string input is coerced
to a string and simply fails to match, so it still returns the original
price.

Tests (test/discount.test.js):
- SPRING15 takes 15% off (200 -> 170)
- codes are case-insensitive ("spring15" -> 170)

The 4 tests in the file pass with `node --test test/discount.test.js`.

Not included: expiry dates for codes. SPRING15 is currently valid
indefinitely until it is removed from CODES.
